==English==
{{swp}}
[[File:Measured Circle Drawing Template or Stencil.JPG|thumb|right|Template for drawing measured circles]]

===Etymology===
Alteration of {{m|en|templet}}, probably from {{borrowed|en|fr|templet}}, diminutive of {{m|fr|temple||a weaver's stretcher}}, variant of {{m|fr|tempe}}, from {{derived|en|la|tempora||temple}}. Alteration of second syllable due to analogy with {{m|en|plate}}. Cognate with {{cog|fo|tamba||to stretch out, relax}}, {{cog|is|þamb||a stretched, bloated, or extended belly}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈtɛm.plɪt/|/ˈtɛm.plət/}}
* {{q|spelling pronunciation}} {{IPA|en|/ˈtɛm(ˌ)pleɪt/|/tɛmˈpleɪt/}}
* {{a|en|HK}} {{IPA|en|/tɛmˈpleɪt/|[tʰɛmˈpʰleɪ̯t̚]}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-template.ogg|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-template.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A [[physical]] [[object]] whose [[shape]] is used as a [[guide]] to make other objects.
# A [[generic]] [[model]] or [[pattern]] from which other objects are based or derived.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2023|author=Clive Young|chapter={{smallcaps|chapter one}}: How Scots Works|title=Unlocking Scots: The Secret Life of the Scots Language|isbn=9781804250495|oclc=1351463323|publisher=Luath Press Limited|location=w:Edinburgh|page=29|passage=Gaelic also benefits from having a readily available '''template''' for Celtic minority language revitalisation, derived from Welsh and Irish.}}
# {{lb|en|computing}} A [[file]] or [[document]] serving as a basis for others.
# {{lb|en|molecular biology}} A [[macromolecule]] which provides a pattern for the synthesis of another molecule.
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2002|author=S. Lottin; et al.|title=Thioredoxin post-transcriptional regulation by H19 provides a new function to mRNA-like non-coding RNA|journal=Nature|volume=21|issue=10|url=http://www.nature.com/onc/journal/v21/n10/abs/1205233a.html
|passage=Classically, the functional product of coding genes is a protein whose synthesis is directed by an mRNA-'''template'''.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170514180418/http://www.nature.com:80/onc/journal/v21/n10/abs/1205233a.html|archivedate=14 May 2017}}
# {{lbl|en|object-oriented}} A partially defined [[class]] or [[function]], that can be [[instantiate]]d in a variety of ways depending on the instantiation [[argument]]s.
# A strip of metal used in boiler-making, pierced with a series of holes, and serving as a guide in marking out a line of rivet-holes.
# {{lb|en|weaving}} {{syn of|en|temple}}.
#* {{quote-book|en|title=Spinning and weaving with wool|author=Paula Simmons|year_published=1977|year=1987|ISBN=0914718282|page=180
|text=The '''template''' length is adjusted to the proper fabric width. Then the sharp pins in the '''template''' ends are hooked into the selvedge edges (with the '''template''' open).}}

|passage=Only that part of the floor timber that bears on the planking and keel need be '''templated'''; {{...}}}}
